messages:
Alex: Quick thread to decide signals for v1->v2 deprecation banners. goal: accurate, low-noise. proposal: 7d token-share + 24h spike detector + fallback/error gating.
Mei: 7d token-share makes sense. prefer token-weighted primary because cost is main concern. keep request-count as secondary.
Jon: Add cause hints: OLD_SDK, HEADER_STRIP, PROXY_REWRITE. helpful for triage.
Sara: UX: banner should show long-term % and a link to modal with graphs + suggested fixes. allow tenants to request a 14-day grace from modal.
Alex: Telemetry event: `versioning.deprecation_signal` with dims tenant_id, routeset, window, token_share, request_share, fallback_pct, cause_hint, sampling_rate.
Mei: Sampling rules: full compute for >300rps tenants; 1-in-10 for smaller. record sampling_rate in event.
Jon: Metrics to export: redwood_v1_token_share, redwood_v1_request_share, redwood_v1_fallback_rate. keep routeset out of Prom labels to avoid high cardinality.
Sara: Exemptions: console should support per-route exemptions with owner and TTL. show exemptions collapsed in modal.
Alex: Alerts: PD only for sustained fallback/error: fallback >2% for 6h or error >1% for 1h. banners only informational.
Mei: Implementation notes: normalize headers (`X-Redwood-Version` + `Redwood-Version`) to avoid false positives. produce route_mapping export for ambiguous proxies.
Jon: Estimator: analytics will produce coarse cost delta for migrating to v2 (estimator_confidence label low/med/high). good for CTA.
deploy-bot: Rolling feature branch `deprec-signals` created. staging flag `v1_deprec_banner` default=off. deploy planned Fri 04:00 UTC.
Alex: Action items: Mei -> event schema PR; Jon -> metrics + estimator; Sara -> UX mock + modal copy; infra -> deploy plan. reconvene next Tue.
